description: This file implements a data repository for a customer repair request application, supporting both localStorage and Supabase as data backends. It provides functions to create, list, retrieve, and update repair requests, with fallback mechanisms for error handling.

methods.name: makeId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for local repair requests.

methods.name: createRepairRequest
methods.description: Creates a new repair request, using Supabase or localStorage.

methods.name: listRepairRequests
methods.description: Lists all repair requests ordered by most recent.

methods.name: getRepairRequestById
methods.description: Fetches a single repair request by its ID.

methods.name: updateRepairRequestStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a repair request.
